**Description**
**Software Engineer \- Blue Yonder**
 Are you a technical expert passionate about logistics innovation? We're seeking an energetic Software Engineer to design and implement a new Warehouse Management System (WMS) solution. In this highly analytical role, you will execute projects, ensure successful WMS implementations, and drive operational excellence.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love This Role:**
* You’ll work with a team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Every day presents new opportunities to grow, lead, and make an impact
* Salary Range: Your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. We anticipate this role to pay a minimum base salary of $105,000, but actual base pay will depend on the successful candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Insert the statement.


**What You'll Do:**
* You'll be a technical expert for the project team, ensuring the successful delivery of our WMS goals and development. You will act as a subject matter expert, aligning system functionality with customer needs and operational goals.
* Design and optimize Blue Yonder WMS functionality using WMS configurations or by developing and/or modifying existing MOCA commands, triggers, SQL scripts, or by utilizing Pagebuilder and JavaScript; ensuring all changes are delivered via standard rollout packages.
* Write and maintain stored procedures, triggers, functions, and scripts to support core WMS functionality, reporting, and automation.
* Collaborate with operations and project teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and database logic that meet KPIs and SLAs.
* Perform system configuration and custom development to enable new features and workflows.
* Lead testing, troubleshooting, and debugging of MOCA/SQL code code and application logic within Blue Yonder Trace files to ensure reliability, performance, and quick resolution of issues.
* Create and maintain functional and technical design documents to capture development work.
* Provide technical support and hands\-on training for operations teams, acting as a WMS subject matter expert.
* Evaluate system performance and propose improvements through database optimization, indexing, and query tuning.
* Partner with integration teams to ensure clean data flows (EDI, API, SFTP, etc.), with focus on downstream impacts to SQL\-based applications.
* Act as a change agent to support transition from as\-is to to\-be systems and processes.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* 3\+ years leading Blue Yonder WMS experience or programming expertise; including functional, technical, implementation or deployment is required.
* 3\+ years of experience leading WMS Implementations, warehouse operations focused continual improvement, or other relevant experience.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, both external and internal, are key to this role
* Demonstrated planning, task organizing and execution skills.
* Working knowledge of popular agile software development methodologies, Lean, etc.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Microsoft Office products
* A willingness to travel approximately 10% of the time.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.


**CJ Logistics About Statement:**
 CJ Logistics delivers integrated and multimodal logistics services, connecting every corner of the world via air, sea, and land. As a lead logistics partner (LLP), third\-party logistics provider (3PL), and supply chain consultant, we help customers leverage supply chain management as a competitive advantage, reducing total system costs, transforming business processes, improving service, and facilitating growth and change. With a focus on social responsibility and sustainability through growth with customers and communities, we prioritize the well\-being of the end consumer, our customers, and our employees. CJ Logistics is responsible for the North region, specializing in solutions for regulated industries such as food and beverage, consumer\-packaged goods, healthcare and medical supplies, and tire and automotive.
